title: Canonical trial/unit/channel identity promoted from convention to enforced gate
question: Two independently observed failure classes (trial_num per-block counter; unit_id per-probe kilosort counter) used local counters as global identities. Is that enough recurrence to justify deterministic prevention rather than another agent instruction?
decision: Yes. Hamm 2026-08-29. Canonical keys are now enforced in code and tested, not merely documented.
forbidden_join_keys: unit_id (unless probe is part of the key)

receipts.raw_unit_id_is_probe_local: sub-V182o_ses-260702 _units_df: unit_id has 137 unique values across 409 units; for probeA rows 0-5 unit_id is exactly equal to local_index; group_name has 4 values (probeA/B/C/D).
receipts.class_csv_is_row_position: pilot_v182o_260702_unitclass.csv unit_id == arange(409); agreement with _units_df by row position: peak_channel_id 409/409, area 409/409.
receipts.channel_id_is_session_unique: LFP signal_metadata: channel_id 512 unique of 512 rows; local_index only 128 unique across 4 probes x 128 -> probe-local.
receipts.c0_c3_already_group_scoped: spk_lfp_pilot.resolve_channel_sets restricts to sm['probe'] == probe (line 103) and measures separation in within-probe local_index; own channel located via session-unique channel_id. No cross-probe leakage possible.
receipts.pilot_table_backfilled: spk_lfp_pilot_v182o_260702_cells.csv rewritten carrying session_id, unit_row_idx, probe, raw_unit_id, area; area agreement pilot vs canonical 6400/6400, zero mismatches.

independent_rederivation_of_o_plus_mappi.hazard_demonstrated_within_these_20: raw_unit_id 22 = row 98 (probeB, FEF) AND row 298 (probeD, TEO); raw_unit_id 107 = row 183 (probeB, FEF) AND row 379 (probeD, TEO). A join on raw_unit_id would have collapsed an FEF unit with a TEO unit -- the same defect class that mislabelled 6 units.

notes: The real-data tests assert the ASSUMPTION, not only the code: if raw unit_id ever becomes session-unique the test fails, forcing re-derivation rather than silent reliance on a stale premise.
This closes the identity half of the gate. It does NOT license interpreting the pilot's biological output; see open_gaps.
open_gaps: Per-fold R^2 is not retained -- spk_lfp_pilot._held_out_r2 pools out-of-fold predictions into a single R^2. Fold distributions require a re-run.
Ridge alpha is fixed at 1.0 and never tuned. 'Inadequate regularization' therefore remains an untested alternative explanation for delta_pred < 0.

No targeted positive control exists for the delta_pred statistic itself on real data. The nuisance model being predictive (R^2 ~ 0.20) shows the regression works, but not that this statistic would detect band-power -> firing dependence if present.
